# Unsigned
Private weekly team check-ins. Apache-2.0. See README.md for setup and limitations.
All inference uses firebase/ai (firebase 13.4.0). Routing source of truth: src/policy.js.
Raw input: ONLY_ON_DEVICE rewrite and identifying-detail detection. Never forward to cloud.
Cloud grouping: approved rewrites only; requires at least three matched participant markers; each is one anonymous sign-in per question. Theme bands count supporting markers.
Administrator question drafting: PREFER_ON_DEVICE. Demo uses real on-device generation when available; only unavailable-device cloud fallback is simulated from the request.
MCP: node mcp/server.js (stdio, local user access). No inference.
get_themes: aggregate title, summary, respondent band only.
draft_check_in_question: administrator request returned as draft; no inference.
schedule_check_in: local draft file only; never schedules or publishes.
Never expose raw or individual approved responses or themes supported by fewer than three anonymous sign-ins per question. Marker UIDs and response linkage never enter AI or MCP output.
MCP live mode reads only an administrator-exported safe theme file; it has no Firestore credentials.
Participant counts are not proof of distinct humans; another anonymous sign-in can answer again. UID exists only in the separate participant path and can be joined to the response by administrators.
Do not commit real Firebase configuration, App Check debug values, personal data or secrets.
